description: Rolled-up OSHA enforcement history for an establishment: how many inspections, how many violations, total initial and current penalty amounts across all of them, the most recent inspection date, and the distinct establishment names OSHA has on file matching the search (chains and renamed sites often appear under several). Answers "has OSHA fined X", "total OSHA penalties for X", "how many times has OSHA inspected X", "OSHA enforcement summary for X". Narrower and faster to read than paging through osha_inspections yourself. Example: osha_establishment_summary({ name: "Walmart", state: "AR" }). Live US Dept. of Labor data, refreshed daily; capped at the 50 most recent inspections per establishment — narrow with state for a complete count on a national chain.

name.description: Establishment / company name, or a fragment of it. Matched as an upper-cased substring.

state.description: 2-letter US state postal code to narrow to one state, e.g. "AR".

name: osha_establishment_summary
title: Osha Establishment Summary
